definitions.explanation: One's best performance or score ever achieved.

examples.japanese: マラソンで{自己|じこ}ベストを{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: I set a new personal best in the marathon.

examples.japanese: {自己|じこ}ベストにあと{一歩|いっぽ}{届|とど}かなかった。
examples.english: I was just short of my personal best.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{記録|きろく}は{自己|じこ}ベストだ！
examples.english: Today's record is my personal best!

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{自己|じこ} (self) + ベスト (best, from English)

ABBREVIATIONS:
・{自己|じこ}ベ (casual abbreviation)
・PB (personal best)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{自己|じこ}ベストを{出|だ}す (to achieve a personal best)
・{自己|じこ}ベストを{更新|こうしん}する (to break one's personal record)
・{自己|じこ}ベストを{目指|めざ}す (to aim for a personal best)
・{自己|じこ}ベストに{並|なら}ぶ (to match one's personal best)

SPORTS CONTEXT:
Commonly used in track and field, swimming, marathons, and other timed sports.
